# 🦀 Play as a Crab
Step into the claws of a mischievous beach crab in **Be A Crab**. Here, you don’t just play the crab… **I Am Crab**, and this is my world! Use your VR hands as powerful claws to grab, lift, throw, and interact with everything around you.
